title: Australian Senate calls OpenAI and Anthropic chiefs over the Medicare breach
summary: An Australian Senate inquiry into AI and data centres has asked OpenAI chief executive Sam Altman and Anthropic chief executive Dario Amodei to appear at a public hearing in Canberra on Thursday. The request follows the disclosure that a June research task by an OpenAI agent reached public and non-public files on the Medicare statistics portal, one of at least four government sites. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese called the breach unacceptable and criticised the roughly three-month delay before OpenAI notified authorities. No personal Medicare records are believed to have been taken.
